description: Searches the whole publication at once and says what kind each hit is: news articles, First Light items, entity records, projects, source documents and tracker pages. This is the broad search — prefer it when the question is not already about one kind of thing, because search_articles and the other per-kind tools look only in their own kind. Matching ignores case AND accents, so "Male" finds "Malé"; a query wrapped in slashes (/min(istry|ister)/) is a regular expression. Every hit carries the canonical URL to cite. Searches the most recent 400 stories and 45 First Light editions, and all reference records. Paginates: when more results remain, the structured answer has a nextCursor (absent on the last page). To continue, call this tool again with the same arguments and cursor set to that value. The cursor moves every kind on together: each page shows the next `limit` hits of each kind.

cursor.description: Continue a previous result: the nextCursor it returned, unchanged. Only valid with the same other arguments (limit may differ).

limit.description: Hits to return per kind (1-25, default 8).

q.description: Words to look for, or /a regular expression/.

name: search_site

found.description: Hits of this kind in all.

kind.description: What the hits are, e.g. "News articles" or "Projects".

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page: pass it back as the cursor argument, with the same other arguments. Absent on the last page.

total.description: Every hit across all kinds, not just this page.

title: Search everything
